toolbooks.description: ToolBooks is a US bookkeeping and payroll SaaS. The platform unifies accounting, bank reconciliation, invoicing and vendor payments into a single product for small businesses.
highlights: Owned the platform frontend: designed and defined the product architecture, prioritizing scalability, maintainability and consistency across teams.
Built and integrated the critical business flows — payments, banking and authentication — with external providers like Plaid, Stripe and AWS Cognito.

Refactored backend modules (Nest.js, TypeORM, PostgreSQL) to harden user-data security, optimized repositories and endpoints, and built Stripe webhooks, Socket.io WebSocket connections and REST endpoints.
Led the team's code reviews and brought AI tooling into the development flow, always under my own review, to speed up testing and UI implementation.

precision-logistica.description: Precisión Logística is a Colombian freight transport and logistics company that integrates transport, logistics talent and technology to guarantee operational continuity for cargo-generating companies.
highlights: I was the only frontend developer on the project: single-handedly built the frontend of all 4 portals (internal, client, HR and point of sale) of a multi-role logistics SaaS.
Designed high-complexity interfaces on a scalable, high-performance architecture, and built the complete quoting, service-order, HR and client-portal modules.
Integrated the platform end-to-end with RNDC, Colombia's government freight dispatch system.

Coordinated authentication security and role-based access control with the backend team; set the automated testing strategy (80% coverage on auth and the API client) and documented architecture decisions as ADRs.

geeks5g.description: Geeks5G is an Austin (USA) agency offering digital marketing, web design and custom software development for small and medium businesses.
highlights: Built the entire frontend of Emergency Service (getservice.ai): the dispatch logic I designed automatically assigns and re-escalates to the nearest professional.
The platform runs in production in the United States today, with 30+ active locksmiths and 300+ completed jobs.
Solved non-trivial business rules, such as tax rates that change from one US state to another, and integrated Google Maps, geocoding and Twilio/Payarc webhooks.
Defined the state architecture with TanStack Query and Redux, and translated each client's business requirements into technical solutions.

bancolombia.description: Bancolombia is one of Colombia's largest banks and a financial group present across several Latin American countries. It offers personal, business and investment banking services.
highlights: Built internal monitoring interfaces that improved the team's traceability and incident resolution in a high-criticality banking environment.
Wrote unit tests to ensure deployment reliability and quality, and took part in code migrations between repositories.
Collaborated on code reviews, contributing to the team's consistency and best practices.

dicosoft.description: DicoSoft Digital is a digital marketing agency specialized in medical clinics and practices, with complementary web development services. Its clients are mainly in healthcare (dentistry, dermatology, aesthetics).
highlights: Built platforms in React and WordPress that lifted client conversion rates by 25%.
Optimized GoHighLevel workflows, improving clients' operational efficiency by 35%.
Managed hosting, DNS and security protocols to keep client platforms stable.

radkiddo.description: Rad Kiddo is a US-based kids' streetwear brand. It sells tees, hoodies, pants and shorts through a Shopify online store, shipping across the USA.
highlights: Designed and built a hybrid e-commerce platform: React for high-interactivity components and WordPress/WooCommerce for catalog management, lifting conversion by 25%.
Implemented the MercadoPago payment gateway and dynamic geolocation, improving user experience and site performance by 30%.
Integrated Cloudinary for optimized media handling and advanced JavaScript for custom cart and filter behavior.

Technologies.label: Process & stack
Technologies.title: How I take a problem to production
Technologies.subtitle: Four decisions I make on every project, always in this order.

understand.title: Frame the problem
understand.desc: I start with the why, not the ticket: what the business is actually deciding, what the user really needs, what the system constrains. If the requirement doesn't hold up, I push back before writing it, not after.

architecture.title: Architecture that scales
architecture.desc: The fiftieth feature should cost what the first one did. A coupled system does not get changed: it gets rewritten.

build.title: Implementation with judgment
build.desc: Real server state, production integrations and accessibility from the first component — not as a pass at the end. I use AI to speed up the mechanical parts; what lands in the repo goes through my review.

quality.title: Quality & handoff
quality.desc: I test where failure is expensive, not where coverage is easy. I measure before optimizing, and leave the context written down for whoever inherits the code.

About.label: About
About.title: Beyond the Code
About.quote: The system decides; the component obeys.
bio: I trained in electronics, robotics and mechatronics engineering, with a diploma in IoT, before moving into the web. That background shaped how I approach problems: I map the whole machine first, then drop down to the part.

These days I work with product teams on what usually hurts once a SaaS scales: complex business logic, multi-role systems, real-time data. I like being handed ownership of the whole problem, whatever the domain.
I also use AI inside my own workflow, for testing and for UI, always under my own review, because speed only matters if what comes out actually works. What I care about most is staying sharp.

interestsBody.travel: New cultures, new people, and seeing the world's wonders with my own eyes. Knowing there's always more to discover is what makes me feel alive.
interestsBody.hiphop: When I dance it, I let go of the emotional weight. Dancing is how I set myself free.
interestsBody.kungfu: My favorite movie. It taught me that the secret to achieving what you want is believing in yourself.
interestsBody.animals: To me they're the purest, most genuine beings on the planet. I love them.
interestsBody.mechatronics: As a kid I dreamed of a life like 'Meet the Robinsons'; that's why I studied Mechatronics with an IoT diploma. My goal is to merge software with the robotics I learned.
